description: A --state seed, --resume last --force: a resume: restart dynamic `d` drops its stale `x`/`reader` and reruns, so a bare {{d.x.value}} inside `d` reads the fresh node, same as {{prime.d.x.value}}; a plain dynamic `e`'s unfinished `first` reruns and reads its already-completed, saved sibling `second` bare, same as dotted -- fails (renders empty) on main, where a plain dynamic's own bare reference never resolved at all. Python-only: the conformance harness always invokes electricity through its legacy positional form, which has no `--state` of its own (#752's precedent); `test_run_cli_parity.py` covers this restart-and-saved-state shape, bare and dotted, on both engines' own `run` subcommand instead.
